about: The eval set: saved jobs whose recordings are frozen into ~/.agentcast/eval/jobs/ (eval freeze) and re-cut on every change (eval run). Each job is cut music-led, with art direction from the rules table, the way the worker makes a launch film. A job may pin a skeleton; otherwise the worker's pick is part of what's being tested. Held-out jobs are for checking a change, not for tuning one: don't look at them while you work.
